theorems.name: Submission.tangent_points_lipschitz_graph_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (L : ℝ), 0 < L → L ≤ 1 → ∀ (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (P : Grassmannian N n), ∃ Γ : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N), (∀ i, IsClosed (Γ i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ Γ i, ∀ z ∈ Γ i, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) ∧ ∀ (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → (∀ v : Euclidean N, ‖Grassmannian.project T v - Grassmannian.project P v‖ ≤ L / 4 * ‖v‖) → ∃ i, x ∈ Γ i
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
